nom: ANUA Azelaic Acid 10 Hyaluron Redness Soothing Pad

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, most often report reduced redness, cooling relief, and no stinging or irritation, though a few say the pads triggered new bumps, purging, or redness on their skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, eczema- or rosacea-prone skin describe the pads as gentle and hydrating, saying they calm redness without stripping or tightening the skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some prone to redness or occasional breakouts, report the pads calm redness and leave skin soft without adding grease, even on their oilier areas.
segments.oily: The one reviewer with an oily T-zone and visible pores on her nose reports the pads helped balance her skin and clear excess sebum without over-drying it.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature and sometimes irritated reports the pads visibly reduce redness, soften rough patches, and hydrate deeply.

concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including many with rosacea, report the pads calm redness quickly, sometimes within minutes, with a cooling and soothing effect; a couple describe the opposite reaction, with one saying her skin turned red and splotchy after use and another developing irritation bumps on her forehead.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the pads as hydrating and plumping, with several saying it let them use less separate moisturizer and that skin never felt tight or stripped; one reviewer found the essence felt like water with no moisturizing effect at all.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers, including one with an oily T-zone, say the pads left their skin barrier feeling balanced and supported rather than stripped; none report barrier damage or increased reactivity from regular use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report their post-acne marks and scarring faded and their skin tone looked more even with regular use, including one who felt a small burn mark healed lighter than expected; no reviewer reports spots getting worse.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone, report fewer breakouts and calmer existing blemishes over time; others report the opposite, including one whose whole face broke out after two uses and two who developed new closed comedones or purging on the treated areas, which one attributed to azelaic acid bringing existing acne to the surface.
concerns.oiliness: The one reviewer with an oily T-zone and enlarged nose pores reports the pads helped keep her skin balanced and reduced excess sebum without leaving it dry.

aspects.libelle: Hygienic tweezers included for pad removal
Pads generously soaked, stretch to cover face
Serum feels sticky to some users

extraits.texte: I used it for two days and my whole face broke out. It's 100% from this because it's the only thing I added to my skincare routine. I will definitely be returning it!

I tried the toner pads because I liked the serum from this brand. My skin is very sensitive I've had rosacea from a young age, this didn't agree with my skin and gave me small irratation bumps all over my forehead. It might work for someone who's skin isn't very sensitive.

I really wanted to love these toner pads. I have redness from acne scarring that I was hoping these pads would help with along with adding some hydration to my skin. I've used these pads about 8 different times (16 pads total) and havent been impressed. Everytime I use them, I wake up the next morning with new closed comedones on my face wherever I had applied the pads the night before. Azelaic azid is known to cause purging so it technically is still non comedogenic because its not creating new acne, its bring old acne to the surface. But this defeats the purpose of buying them for my specific goal of reducing redness from acne scarring if its just bringing more acne to the surface. Its possible that if I stick with using them, they could eventually help but I'm too impatient for that and theres so many other great products out there that actually improve my skin. Overall, disappointing.

I like how soaked the pads are and how big the pads are. Theyre bigger than orher brands. What i didnr like is that they felt like water on my face. It didnt feel moisturizing at all. I expected a soothing/tingling sensation but it was not at all. Ineill admit i didnt use them long enough to see any benefits. I love this line but not this product
I have Rosacea/sensitive/dry skin. This company has helped my face so much! Better than what the doc prescribed!

Product was received as part of an educational promotion. These toners pads are so good. I have dry skin that is prone to rosacea and eczema. I have redness around my nose area and chin. I also am prone to break outs and little bumps. These toner pads are so gently and hydrating. They feel really nice on the face. I can see the redness go down visibly. My face feels clean as it swipes off all the dirt and oils from my face. I have used this prior to putting on makeup and it works really well under makeup too. It makes the skin soft and even. And is a good first step for skin prep. I wash my face and then on a clean dry face, I go in with the pads. I love that this has tweezers to grab the pads so it remains clean and hygienic. It feels very refreshing.

extraits.titre: Full facial coverage with one wipe!
extraits.texte: Uhhh wow where have these been all my life! I love how easy and durable these are! they STRETCH -- so one wipe is all you need for your full face! love how inexpensive yet effective and convenient these facial pads are! I tend to get bigger pores on my nose that I'm always a little self conscious about -- and these toning pads have been great at keeping my skin balanced, and helping my oily t zone and nose area! My skin looks so much cleaner and has been so much softer from using these before applying the rest of my skin care routine! I love that they are gentle for redness prone skin, and help keep my skin barrier balanced, while also helping to rid my skin of excess sebum and dead skin! My skin has been so much softer and brighter since using these consistently and you only need one pad since it can cover your entire face! Super easy to use, and the perfect step before applying your skin care or makeup over your skin!! I recieved this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
